observations.body: Above the living beings and platform, Ezekiel sees a throne, a human-like figure, fire, brightness, and rainbow likeness called the LORD’s glory.
observations.label: Glory appears in human likeness and fire: action

observations.body: Ezekiel falls on his face and hears a voice.
observations.label: Glory appears in human likeness and fire: response

observations.body: likeness · appearance · human form · rainbow · glory
observations.label: Words in Ezekiel 1:26–28

payload.posture: Read Ezekiel 1:26–28 as the prophetic voice evidence before carrying it into another source.
payload.tension: The prophet repeatedly says “likeness” and “appearance,” resisting a simple claim that God’s form has been fully seen.
payload.title: Glory appears in human likeness and fire
